summary: Slice R + O.2 + L + P verification. Backend: 12/12 of test_slice_r_o2_l_batch.py + 6/7 of new test_slice_r_o2_supplemental.py all green (decline reason persistence, request-changes 422, invalid-token 401, tech RBAC on /decline & /pdf, revoke double-call 409, cross-tenant credit isolation). Frontend: customer portal home renders portal-my-referrals-list, customer estimate view has NO pricing-leak columns (headers: DESCRIPTION/QTY-HR/VISITS/TOTAL only) and NO banned totals rows (no Estimated Profit / Total B.Hrs / Total B.Hrs Revenue). Admin /workstream breadcrumbs render correctly (Home > Workstream, aria-label=Breadcrumb, aria-current=page on Workstream). Root '/' does NOT render breadcrumbs. Only one FAILURE: Slice L.c TTL index missing on widget_denied_requests collection.

minor.issue: Slice L.c invariant violated: `_ensure_denied_indexes()` is defined in /app/backend/routers/widget_config.py:145 but is NEVER invoked from server.startup or elsewhere. Collection has 0 indexes; TTL index `widget_denied_ttl_7d` and compound `widget_denied_tenant_time` never get created. GET /api/tenants/mine/widget-config/denied-requests still returns 200 with {"denied":[]}, but auto-expiration of 7-day rows will not happen — collection will grow unbounded until the process-local trim cap (500/tenant) kicks in on new inserts. Fix: add `await _ensure_denied_indexes()` to server.startup (or wire the widget_config router startup hook).

action_items: P2: Wire `_ensure_denied_indexes()` into FastAPI startup (server.py) so Slice L.c TTL + tenant/time indexes are actually created on boot. Currently the invariant 'widget_denied_ttl_7d + tenant-time index' cannot be satisfied without a manual call.

P3 (nit): problem statement asks for `estimate-locked-pill` testid, but component uses `estimate-accepted-pill` / `estimate-declined-pill` (EstimateView.jsx:226). Not a bug — just note testid divergence for future test authors.
critical_code_review_comments: widget_config.py:145 defines `_ensure_denied_indexes()` but no caller — likely missed a `@app.on_event('startup')` wire-up during Slice L.c migration to Mongo. Confirmed via runtime probe: `db.widget_denied_requests.index_information() == {}` and collection empty.

EstimateView.jsx correctly gates admin toolbar via `showAdminToolbar`; customer path (line 200-216) exposes only accept/decline/request-changes buttons. Totals table (line 335+) omits estimated_profit / total_b_hrs / total_b_hrs_revenue rows entirely from customer render — verified in DOM.
Backend estimate_viewer.py accept endpoint correctly returns 409 on 2nd call (line 255-256). Magic-link invalid token returns 401 as expected.

success_rate.backend: 94% (18/19 across new + existing Slice R/O.2/L suites)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for verified surfaces (portal home referrals list, customer estimate view no-pricing-leak, admin breadcrumbs on /workstream, no breadcrumbs on landing '/')

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Slice R/O.2/L/P acceptance criteria are green backend + frontend EXCEPT: `_ensure_denied_indexes()` is never called on startup, so widget_denied_requests has no TTL/tenant-time indexes at rest. After main agent wires it into server.startup, re-run `pytest backend/tests/test_slice_r_o2_supplemental.py::test_widget_denied_ttl_index` — that single test will flip green.
rca of the issue: Slice L.c author added _ensure_denied_indexes() in widget_config.py:145 (idempotent create_index for TTL + compound tenant-time) but forgot to register it as a startup hook. FastAPI never calls it, and Motor does not lazily create Python-declared indexes. Reproduction: `db.widget_denied_requests.index_information()` returns `{}`. Mitigation: append `await _ensure_denied_indexes()` inside server.py's startup event handler, or expose it via a router-level `@router.on_event('startup')`.
